text:
maria: Morning—noticed recurrent p95 blasts in eu-west-3 during prefix-warmup windows (~03:10 UTC). Small set of nodes show NVLink retransmits + egress queue spikes.

alex: Confirmed. Topo highlights 4 nodes (rack-21) with simultaneous qdepth and brief pci resets. Looks like many mid-sized generators aligning.

jamal: Shared tenants mostly? Any single noisy tenant?

maria: Shared, no single offender. Alignment-triggered noisy neighbor.

kevin: Quick trace req=tx-warm-900: egress proxy queuing added ~140ms. PromQL I used: max_over_time(egress_proxy_queue_len{region="eu-west-3"}[5m]) by (node) and histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(gpu_exec_latency_bucket[1m])) by (le,node)).

olga: Can we isolate warmups without SDK changes?

alex: Idea: create tiny ephemeral "warmup-shed" (2 GPUs) and route auto-detected warmups there. Detector: kvcache_miss_rate delta >25% && prefix_len>96 -> tag header X-Auto-Warm:1. Tag-only first.

jamal: Scheduler: AllocationClass warmup-shed-ephemeral selector gpu_role=warmup-shed ephemeralTTL=10m preempt=false. Pin 2 nodes to start.

kevin: Staging replay: steering warmups to a mini-silo reduced egress p95 ~50% and NVLink retransmit ~60%. Median unaffected. Token/sec on warmup path down ~3% due to shaping.

maria: Rollout plan: 24h detector tag-only to measure FP rate; if <2% FP, enable routing for 5% of auto-tags for 30m. Rollback gates: region_egress_p95 > baseline*1.4 OR nvlink_err_rate >2x OR warmup-shed_queue_len>100 for >2m.

olga: I'll file finance note and create a cost cap for the trial. SRE-bot, add alert warmup-shed-pressure (slack-only) with 3m hold.

sre-bot: Alert warmup-shed-pressure created (severity: warning), paging disabled.

maria: Good. Jamal, please create the AllocationClass in staging and prod labels when we greenlight. Keep the tag-only detector behind a feature flag.

jamal: On it. Allocation class created in staging, labels applied, starting tag-only run.

maria: Thanks—I'll monitor metrics and post results.
